name: multiselect
title: Multiselect
description: Searchable async multiselect, a preset over Combobox's parts with Base UI's multiple: chips are cells in the field frame, the list docks to it.
whenToUse: Use it to search and pick several values as tokens in a field. For one value use Combobox or Select; for a few fixed choices use Checkbox group.

parts.name: Multiselect
parts.description: Searchable async multiselect. Chips are yellow cells in the field frame; the list docks to the frame. Selected options stay listed while new matches stream in; requests are aborted when superseded. Escape closes the list; on a closed field it clears only typed text, never the chips (Base UI would clear them all): a chip's remove cell, Backspace and Clear remove.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the list's portal renders (defaults to <body>).

props.name: label
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (e.g. a toolbar); the label is visually hidden.

props.name: loadOptions
props.description: Async source. Called on open (query "") and on every input change; earlier requests are aborted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen options and Base UI's event details (the reason, the event).
